# Optimized runtime textures

WebP derivatives of the original files in `../v2/`, generated by `tools/optimize-assets.py`.
The original authors, download references and licenses remain in `../v2/SOURCES.json` and the application flight manual. No additional third-party images are introduced in V4. Dimensions are capped at 1024 px for surface maps and 2048 px for planetary/sky images; normal/roughness maps remain linear data textures in the renderer.

`manifest.json` records the source-to-runtime mapping and byte totals. The original JPEGs are retained for provenance. The runtime requests the optimized paths through `asset-map.js`. The optional HDR retains its original license and file.
